question: What does the Greek word 'ekklesia' (Church) literally mean?

choices.A: An assembly of those called out

teaching.title: Ekklesia — Called Out Assembly
teaching.body: 'Ekklesia' comes from 'ek' (out of) + 'kaleo' (to call). In classical Greek it referred to a civic assembly of citizens summoned by a herald. The Septuagint (Greek OT) uses it for the assembly of Israel before God. In the NT, it becomes the standard word for the Christian community — those called out of the world and gathered by God. This etymology undergirds the theological idea of the Church as not self-created but summoned by God's word.
